summary: Frontend-only iteration 2 re-test completed against the external URL. All requested functional regressions and role flows passed: salary PUT/payment toast/slip, overlay-sensitive navigation, full exam marks/results, student RBAC navigation and pages, teacher scoped students/self-attendance, and principal happy path. A minor Radix dialog accessibility warning remains.

ui_bugs.component: DialogContent across Exams, Students, Announcements and Complaints
ui_bugs.issue: Opening dialogs logs repeated Radix accessibility warnings: missing Description or aria-describedby. Functionality is unaffected, but screen-reader context is incomplete.

action_items: Add DialogDescription or explicit aria-describedby={undefined} where descriptions are intentionally omitted to remove Radix accessibility warnings.
Add catch/error states to initial page load requests so failed API calls do not leave users on an indefinite loader.
Add data-testid attributes to remaining interactive form controls such as exam subject/max/date and student parent/monthly-fee inputs.
critical_code_review_comments: Salary slip and report-card download helpers convert every fetch response to a blob without checking response.ok; an authorization/server error could open an error payload as if it were a document.
Several page-level load functions use only .then(...) and no catch/error state, so a failed request can leave Loader visible forever.
Multiple DialogContent instances omit DialogDescription, confirmed by repeated browser console warnings during tested modal flows.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested functional flows passed; 1 minor accessibility warning

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI Retest Student (STU26DDC67), TEST_UI Retest Exam 20260810 with marks for 9 students, and TEST_UI Retest Notice. Marked one pending salary paid, resolved one complaint, and regenerated 20 timetable slots.
test_credentials: Used principal and teacher credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; student STU26441E8 was obtained from the principal Students table and authenticated with the documented default password. /app/auth_testing.md was absent; backend auth playbook checks were out of scope for this frontend-only re-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_1 frontend regressions are functionally fixed. Salary Mark Paid showed slip SAL-260810-38539 and the slip button appeared. The complete TEST_UI exam UI flow persisted 9 ranked/graded results. No visible #webpack-dev-server-client-overlay appeared while navigating Dashboard, Exams, Homework, Complaints, Salary, or during the exam flow. Corrected two test-script-only issues during execution (nav testid typo and overly narrow marks locator); neither was a product defect.
rca_of_the_issue: The remaining warning is caused by Radix DialogContent instances being rendered without DialogDescription/aria-describedby. The iteration_1 product defects were fixed: Salary now calls PUT with caught errors, and ResizeObserver errors no longer produce a pointer-blocking development overlay in the exercised flows.
